explanation:
Earlier counts differ, "even when endpoints look similar."

model_note: Illustrative deterministic model v1, not measurements; equal inoculum 5, capacity 100, maximum rate 0.4/hour; no death modeled. Each trial uses its original saved control. Blank comparison fields mean the control was not recorded. Prediction outcomes refer to hour 24; similar means a difference of at most 2 units.
